mapper.select: SELECT p.term,p.post_id,p.title_hit,p.body_hit FROM post_search_terms t JOIN post_search_postings p ON p.term_hash=t.term_hash WHERE t.term LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO post_search_terms(term_hash,term) SELECT p.term_hash,p.term FROM post_search_postings p WHERE p.post_id=(SELECT MIN(q.post_id) FROM post_search_postings q WHERE q.term_hash=p.term_hash) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post_search_terms t WHERE t.term_hash=p.term_hash)

MERGE INTO post_search_terms(term_hash,term) KEY(term_hash) SELECT p.term_hash,p.term FROM post_search_postings p WHERE p.post_id=(SELECT MIN(q.post_id) FROM post_search_postings q WHERE q.term_hash=p.term_hash) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post_search_terms t WHERE t.term_hash=p.term_hash)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_search_postings WHERE post_id IN (SELECT id FROM travel_posts WHERE author_id=#{id})
mapper.select: SELECT version FROM search_index_state WHERE name='posts'
